cluster.description:
CNPG Cluster definition. Everything that is not `metadata` is passed directly to the CNPG cluster spec.
Prefer the dedicated values below for databases, roles and similar instead of the built-in ones.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/1.30/cloudnative-pg.v1#cluster
cluster.title: cluster

databases.description:
Databases to create in the cluster. Map: database name -> database spec.
Everything that is not metadata is passed directly as database spec.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/1.30/cloudnative-pg.v1#database
databases.title: databases

databaseRoles.description:
Database roles to create in the cluster. Map: role name -> database role spec.
Everything that is not metadata is passed directly as database role spec, and the cluster is filled out for you.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/1.30/cloudnative-pg.v1#databaserolespec
databaseRoles.title: databaseRoles

poolers.description:
Poolers to use in the front of the cluster. Map: pooler name -> pooler spec.
Everything that is not metadata is passed directly as pooler spec, and the cluster is filled out for you.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/1.30/cloudnative-pg.v1#pooler
poolers.title: poolers

scheduledBackups.description:
Scheduled backups. Map: backup name -> backup spec.
Everything that is not metadata is passed directly as backup spec, and the cluster is filled out for you.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/1.30/cloudnative-pg.v1#scheduledbackup
scheduledBackups.title: scheduledBackups

barman.description:
Barman-cloud backups. When enabled and at least one scheduled backup uses the barman-cloud plugin, the chart adds the plugin to the cluster and creates the ObjectStore it points at.
Everything that is not `enabled` or `metadata` is passed directly as the ObjectStore spec.
ref: https://cloudnative-pg.io/plugin-barman-cloud/docs/plugin-barman-cloud.v1/#objectstore

enabled.description: Create the barman-cloud ObjectStore and add the plugin to the cluster.
enabled.title: enabled

barman.title: barman

podMonitor.description:
Prometheus PodMonitor for the cluster.
ref: https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator/blob/main/Documentation/api.md#podmonitor

enabled.description: Create a PodMonitor for the cluster pods.
enabled.title: enabled

interval.description: PodMonitor scrape interval, empty uses Prometheus' default.
interval.title: interval

scrapeTimeout.description: PodMonitor scrape timeout, empty uses Prometheus' default.
scrapeTimeout.title: scrapeTimeout

podMonitor.title: podMonitor
